public_body: Swansea Free Public Library Board Of Trustees
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the 48-hour amendment added an unanticipated topic permissibly, and the unclear "MEG" acronym was cured by the notice's specific amount and use details.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly discussed an authorization of grant funds at its June 22 meeting after adding that topic to the notice within 48 hours of the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by amending the June 22 meeting notice to include this unanticipated topic.

allegations.summary: Amended notice allegedly gave insufficient specificity by using the acronym "MEG," which the public would not widely understand.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the additional detail on the amended notice that accompanied this acronym was sufficient to reasonably advise the public of the issue to be discussed at the meeting.
